actionable_bugs.recommended_repair: Route evaluate_goal through GoalsConnector.accrue(AccrueRequest(usage=...)) (and an autonomous consult request) or amend CONN-01/docs/connectors.md to scope the typed boundary to the tool and kernel surface, with the user's approval.
